objects.definition:
enum SpawnMask
{
    SPAWNMASK_CONTINENT         = (1 << REGULAR_DIFFICULTY),

    SPAWNMASK_DUNGEON_NORMAL    = (1 << DUNGEON_DIFFICULTY_NORMAL),
    SPAWNMASK_DUNGEON_HEROIC    = (1 << DUNGEON_DIFFICULTY_HEROIC),
    SPAWNMASK_DUNGEON_ALL       = (SPAWNMASK_DUNGEON_NORMAL | SPAWNMASK_DUNGEON_HEROIC),

    SPAWNMASK_RAID_10MAN_NORMAL = (1 << RAID_DIFFICULTY_10MAN_NORMAL),
    SPAWNMASK_RAID_25MAN_NORMAL = (1 << RAID_DIFFICULTY_25MAN_NORMAL),
    SPAWNMASK_RAID_NORMAL_ALL   = (SPAWNMASK_RAID_10MAN_NORMAL | SPAWNMASK_RAID_25MAN_NORMAL),

    SPAWNMASK_RAID_10MAN_HEROIC = (1 << RAID_DIFFICULTY_10MAN_HEROIC),
    SPAWNMASK_RAID_25MAN_HEROIC = (1 << RAID_DIFFICULTY_25MAN_HEROIC),
    SPAWNMASK_RAID_HEROIC_ALL   = (SPAWNMASK_RAID_10MAN_HEROIC | SPAWNMASK_RAID_25MAN_HEROIC),

    SPAWNMASK_RAID_ALL          = (SPAWNMASK_RAID_NORMAL_ALL | SPAWNMASK_RAID_HEROIC_ALL),
};
objects.description: Bitmask flags selecting which spawn sets apply for different instance difficulties.

functions.name: IsEnumFlag
functions.signature:
template<typename T>
constexpr bool IsEnumFlag(T)
functions.description: Primary detection function for identifying enums that support bitwise flag operators. By default returns false; specific enum types can be opted-in as flag enums using DEFINE_ENUM_FLAG(MyEnum), which provides an overload that returns true for that enum.
requirements: Callers should not rely on this default returning true unless the enum type has been enabled via DEFINE_ENUM_FLAG for that specific enum type.
When using with enum types, ensure you include the header where DEFINE_ENUM_FLAG was invoked for that enum so the overload is visible.

functions.name: operator&
functions.signature:
template<typename T, std::enable_if_t<EnumTraits::IsFlag<T>::value, std::nullptr_t> = nullptr>
inline constexpr T operator&(T left, T right)
functions.description: Bitwise AND operator for enum types that are explicitly marked as flag enums. Returns a value of the same enum with bits set only where both operands have the corresponding bits set.
requirements: T must be an enum type that has been enabled as a flag enum (EnumTraits::IsFlag<T>::value must be true, typically via DEFINE_ENUM_FLAG).
Both operands must be of the same enum type T.
Operands should contain only valid flag bit combinations for T.

functions.name: operator&=
functions.signature:
template<typename T, std::enable_if_t<EnumTraits::IsFlag<T>::value, std::nullptr_t> = nullptr>
inline constexpr T& operator&=(T& left, T right)
functions.description: Compound bitwise AND assignment for flag enums. Updates left to the intersection of left and right and returns a reference to left.
requirements: T must be an enum type enabled as a flag enum (EnumTraits::IsFlag<T>::value is true).
left and right must be of the same enum type T.
left must be a modifiable lvalue.

functions.name: operator|
functions.signature:
template<typename T, std::enable_if_t<EnumTraits::IsFlag<T>::value, std::nullptr_t> = nullptr>
inline constexpr T operator|(T left, T right)
functions.description: Bitwise OR operator for flag enums. Produces a value with bits set where either operand has the corresponding bit set.
requirements: T must be an enum type enabled as a flag enum (EnumTraits::IsFlag<T>::value is true).
Both operands must be of the same enum type T.
Operands should represent valid flag combinations for T.

functions.name: operator|=
functions.signature:
template<typename T, std::enable_if_t<EnumTraits::IsFlag<T>::value, std::nullptr_t> = nullptr>
inline constexpr T& operator|=(T& left, T right)
functions.description: Compound bitwise OR assignment for flag enums. Sets in left any bits present in right and returns a reference to left.
requirements: T must be an enum type enabled as a flag enum (EnumTraits::IsFlag<T>::value is true).
left and right must be of the same enum type T.
left must be a modifiable lvalue.

functions.name: operator~
functions.signature:
template<typename T, std::enable_if_t<EnumTraits::IsFlag<T>::value, std::nullptr_t> = nullptr>
inline constexpr T operator~(T value)
functions.description: Bitwise NOT operator for flag enums. Returns the bitwise complement of the provided enum value, cast back to T.
requirements: T must be an enum type enabled as a flag enum (EnumTraits::IsFlag<T>::value is true).
The result may include bits not defined by T; callers should mask to valid bits as appropriate for their enum.

functions.name: EnumFlag::EnumFlag
functions.signature:
template<typename T>
constexpr EnumFlag<T>::EnumFlag(T value)
functions.description: Implicit constructor for the EnumFlag wrapper, storing a flag-enabled enum value. Provides a type-safe wrapper around bitwise operations for flagged enums.
requirements: Template parameter T must be an enum type enabled as a flag enum (enforced by static_assert: EnumTraits::IsFlag<T>::value).
value must be a valid value of enum type T.

functions.name: EnumFlag::operator&=
functions.signature:
template<typename T>
constexpr EnumFlag<T>& EnumFlag<T>::operator&=(EnumFlag right)
functions.description: Compound bitwise AND assignment between two EnumFlag wrappers. Intersects the set bits of this and right, storing the result in this.
requirements: Both EnumFlag instances must have the same template parameter T.
T must be a flag-enabled enum type (class invariant).

functions.name: EnumFlag::operator&
functions.signature:
template<typename T>
constexpr friend EnumFlag<T> operator&(EnumFlag<T> left, EnumFlag<T> right)
functions.description: Friend non-member bitwise AND for EnumFlag wrappers. Returns the intersection of bits from left and right as a new EnumFlag.
requirements: Both operands must be EnumFlag wrappers over the same enum type T.
T must be a flag-enabled enum type (class invariant).

functions.name: EnumFlag::operator|=
functions.signature:
template<typename T>
constexpr EnumFlag<T>& EnumFlag<T>::operator|=(EnumFlag right)
functions.description: Compound bitwise OR assignment between two EnumFlag wrappers. Sets in this any bits present in right.
requirements: Both EnumFlag instances must have the same template parameter T.
T must be a flag-enabled enum type (class invariant).

functions.name: EnumFlag::operator|
functions.signature:
template<typename T>
constexpr friend EnumFlag<T> operator|(EnumFlag<T> left, EnumFlag<T> right)
functions.description: Friend non-member bitwise OR for EnumFlag wrappers. Returns the union of bits from left and right as a new EnumFlag.
requirements: Both operands must be EnumFlag wrappers over the same enum type T.
T must be a flag-enabled enum type (class invariant).

functions.name: EnumFlag::operator~
functions.signature:
template<typename T>
constexpr EnumFlag<T> EnumFlag<T>::operator~() const
functions.description: Bitwise NOT operator for the EnumFlag wrapper. Returns a new EnumFlag whose bits are the complement of this value.
requirements: T must be a flag-enabled enum type (class invariant).
The complemented result may include bits not defined by T; callers should mask to valid bits as appropriate for their enum.

functions.name: EnumFlag::RemoveFlag
functions.signature:
template<typename T>
constexpr void EnumFlag<T>::RemoveFlag(EnumFlag flag)
functions.description: Clears all bits in this EnumFlag that are set in the provided flag parameter.
requirements: flag must be an EnumFlag of the same enum type T.
T must be a flag-enabled enum type (class invariant).

functions.name: EnumFlag::HasFlag
functions.signature:
template<typename T>
constexpr bool EnumFlag<T>::HasFlag(T flag) const
functions.description: Checks whether any of the bits in flag are set in this EnumFlag. Returns true if there is any overlap between this value and flag.
requirements: flag must be a value of the same enum type T.
Behavior reflects 'any-of' semantics: returns true if at least one bit in flag is set in this.

functions.name: EnumFlag::HasAllFlags
functions.signature:
template<typename T>
constexpr bool EnumFlag<T>::HasAllFlags(T flags) const
functions.description: Checks whether all bits in flags are set in this EnumFlag. Returns true if (value & flags) == flags.
requirements: flags must be a value of the same enum type T.
Represents 'all-of' semantics: all bits specified in flags must be present.

functions.name: EnumFlag::operator T
functions.signature:
template<typename T>
constexpr EnumFlag<T>::operator T() const
functions.description: Implicit conversion operator returning the underlying enum value stored by this EnumFlag. Useful for interop with APIs expecting T.
requirements: Use with care to avoid accidental implicit conversions; consider explicit casts at call sites if ambiguity arises.

functions.name: EnumFlag::AsUnderlyingType
functions.signature:
template<typename T>
constexpr std::underlying_type_t<T> EnumFlag<T>::AsUnderlyingType() const
functions.description: Returns the stored enum value cast to its underlying integral type.
requirements: T must be an enum type so that std::underlying_type_t<T> is defined (true by class design).

functions.name: GetFirstSchoolInMask
functions.signature: inline SpellSchools GetFirstSchoolInMask(SpellSchoolMask mask)
functions.description: Returns the first SpellSchools enum value present in the provided SpellSchoolMask bitmask by scanning from 0 up to MAX_SPELL_SCHOOL-1. If no bits are set, it returns SPELL_SCHOOL_NORMAL. Typical use: determine a representative school from a combined mask.
requirements: mask must be a valid combination of SpellSchoolMask bits; if no bit is set, the function will return SPELL_SCHOOL_NORMAL by design.

functions.name: ClassByQuestSort
functions.signature: inline uint8 ClassByQuestSort(int32 QuestSort)
functions.description: Maps a QuestSort enum/category to a player class (Classes) identifier when the sort refers to a class; otherwise returns 0. Useful for deriving class from quest categorization.
requirements: QuestSort should be one of the QUEST_SORT_* constants that map to classes; for all other values the function returns 0.
Callers must handle the 0 return value (meaning no associated class).

functions.name: SkillByLockType
functions.signature: inline SkillType SkillByLockType(LockType locktype)
functions.description: Translates a LockType (e.g., picking, herbalism, mining, fishing, inscription) into the corresponding SkillType required for that lock. Returns SKILL_NONE for unhandled lock types.
requirements: locktype should be a valid LockType value; for unrecognized types the function returns SKILL_NONE.
Callers must handle SKILL_NONE as 'no specific skill mapped'.

functions.name: SkillByQuestSort
functions.signature: inline uint32 SkillByQuestSort(int32 QuestSort)
functions.description: Maps certain profession-related QuestSort categories to the corresponding SkillType identifier; returns 0 if the quest sort does not correspond to a supported skill.
requirements: QuestSort should be one of the supported profession-related QUEST_SORT_* values; otherwise the return is 0.
Callers must handle the 0 return value (meaning no associated skill).

functions.name: GetPvPTeamId
functions.signature: inline PvPTeamId GetPvPTeamId(TeamId teamId)
functions.description: Converts a TeamId (Alliance/Horde/Neutral) to the corresponding PvPTeamId value used in battlegrounds/arenas. Unknown values map to PVP_TEAM_NEUTRAL.
requirements: teamId should be a valid TeamId (TEAM_ALLIANCE, TEAM_HORDE, or TEAM_NEUTRAL).
Callers should not assume non-neutral result for unsupported values; function returns PVP_TEAM_NEUTRAL in that case.

functions.name: GetTeamId
functions.signature: inline TeamId GetTeamId(PvPTeamId teamId)
functions.description: Converts a PvPTeamId (Alliance/Horde/Neutral) back to the corresponding TeamId. Unknown values map to TEAM_NEUTRAL.
requirements: teamId should be a valid PvPTeamId (PVP_TEAM_ALLIANCE, PVP_TEAM_HORDE, or PVP_TEAM_NEUTRAL).
Callers should handle TEAM_NEUTRAL for unsupported values.

functions.name: Acore::Impl::CurrentServerProcessHolder::type
functions.signature: static ServerProcessTypes Acore::Impl::CurrentServerProcessHolder::type()
functions.description: Returns the current server process type (e.g., authserver or worldserver) from a static holder. Intended for global checks of process context.
requirements: No parameters. Returns the current value of the static member Acore::Impl::CurrentServerProcessHolder::_type.
Callers should treat the return as a snapshot; thread-safety or mutability of _type is not specified here.
